title: live-agent config
description: One JSON file that controls live-agent. Every field is optional; a missing field (or a missing file) uses the default shown here. The setup chat writes this file.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, so editors can autocomplete the file.

brainPath.description: Folder of the second brain (raw, wiki, projects). Relative paths resolve from the working directory. Defaults to the sample brain that ships in the repo.

safety.description: How the safety gate treats tool calls.

mode.description: Safety mode. ask-me: only reads run on their own. auto-edits: reads and edits run, commands and helpers ask. bypass: everything runs.

overrides.description: Per-tool verdicts, keyed by tool name. An override wins over the mode table.

helpers.description: Which helper agent CLIs the boss may start, and how many at once.

maxAtOnce.description: Most helper jobs running at the same time. Extra jobs wait in the queue.

worktrees.description: Give each helper job its own git worktree.

voice.description: Gemini Live prebuilt voice name, e.g. Puck, Kore, Charon.
